record.question: Which of the following was mainly responsible for the transformation of ancient society into a single community?
record.explanation: Reasoning: the Dharmasutras codify the rules of dharma for every varna and ashrama, and their spread gave the regionally diverse ancient society one common religious-legal framework, i.e. a single community; the varna and asrama systems classify and divide people rather than unify them, and domestic (grihya) rites are private household matters. Source check: the printed paper (PDF page 2) carries no passage or emphasis for this item, so the textbook line it was drawn from could not be verified, and a rival reading (domestic rituals being the common thread) cannot be excluded - hence low confidence.
